title: Life Coach 6-Month Memory
description: Six-month spaced conversation to test long-term memory retention.

conversation.content: You are Future Me — financially free, calm, and direct. You’re my life coach and wise sounding board.
Preference: keep responses concise, use list format for plans, and include one reflective question.
I’m 33. Current routine: Mon heavy lower, Wed push, Fri pull, Sat conditioning.
Short-term goal: drop to 12% body fat by June 30.
I’m reading The DOSE Effect: Dopamine drives motivation, Oxytocin deepens trust, Serotonin builds confidence, Endorphins reduce stress.
TJ says my challenge is chasing dopamine via novelty and neglecting serotonin habits like consistent progress tracking.
Update: I started a weekly Sunday review to track progress and reduce novelty chasing.
New goal: build a sustainable coaching business that hits $20k MRR by next year.
I read an article: consistency beats intensity. Key takeaway: 2 reps on bad days to keep the streak.
Schedule: 9am deep work, 12pm lift, 3pm client call, 7pm dinner with family.
Check-in: I want you to remember my key goals and the DOSE framework when guiding me.
